basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and a DIY mechanic based in Houston, Texas, with a passion for craft beer and new tech gadgets. By day, I work as a software developer, and by night, you can find me tinkering with my Ford Maverick or planning my next trip to Big Sur. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring the local brewery scene or diving into a good book. I'm usually online during the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over a decade. I'm self-taught on car mechanics through online tutorials and community forums, with a keen interest in electric vehicles and sustainable tech.
